text.en: Most clients praise the salon for neat breed haircuts, pleasant scented shampoos, and tidy styling. Dog owners frequently report that their pets return looking handsome and smelling fresh after their grooming sessions. However, one owner was unhappy after their puppy developed ear irritation and bald patches following a trim.

Multiple clients highlight the warm, friendly demeanor of the salon workers, giving particular praise to individual groomers such as Ashley. Reviewers appreciate when staff listen to preferences and greet pets with kindness. Nonetheless, one dissatisfied client reported that groomers disregarded specific instructions regarding sensitive ears.

Several pet parents note that staff handle dogs with care, ensuring animals remain comfortable and secure throughout their appointments. Longtime clients mention careful protocols in place to keep pets safe from escaping. Conversely, one client reported that their dog experienced acute discomfort and required a veterinary visit for ear irritation.

q.en: What grooming services does Groomies provide?

a.en: Reviewers mention full dog haircuts, puppy trims, coat brushing, baths, and specialized nail and coat care.

q.en: Can owners request a specific groomer for appointments?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention booking regular monthly appointments with specific preferred groomers like Ashley.

q.en: How does the salon ensure pet safety during visits?

a.en: Reviewers note that the facility maintains multiple safety procedures to supervise dogs and prevent escapes.
